summary: Banco Macro announced the second of three monthly cash dividend installments totaling AR$49,033,753,984.66 (AR$76.6882980676 per share, representing 7,668.8298% of outstanding capital stock of AR$639,390,301), approved at the April 8, 2026 shareholders meeting and authorized by the Central Bank of Argentina. The dividend is available from June 3, 2026, with a record date of June 2, 2026, subject to 7% withholding tax under Income Tax Law section 97. Payment is made through Caja de Valores S.A. and, for ADR holders, via The Bank of New York Mellon under the depositary agreement. Watch for the final installment and currency-stability risk.
